method: Independent read-only source/plan/caller review with delegated native-source partition. Only this evidence note was written; reviewers ran no tests/compiler/browser/provider calls or git mutations.

blockers.finding: The new native Quality context is admitted and appended as plain message text. Neither initial nor follow-up gw.route request supplies beforeDispatch. ensureGateway returns the raw gateway; no private native token or wrapper creates the missing callback. The existing SDK guard therefore cannot revalidate the new source path after later context/capacity/credential waits.
blockers.effect: A project/object grant, current native facts or source disposition can change before outbound SDK dispatch while previously appended text is still sent. Read-time checks do not establish final-dispatch currentness.
blockers.boundedRepair: Retain actual actor/program plus exact admitted native IDs/digests and issue an equality-checking reread callback to both gateway requests. Missing/superseded rows must refuse rather than becoming empty success. Prove the new path with a controlled final-boundary regression; preserve the existing gateway guard and do not expand the unrelated legacy retained-file limitation.

otherFindings: Native catalogue projection is an audited CRE-derived snapshot, with admitted actor/project/exact parent, bounded collection and repeated fact/hash checks; it does not mutate QMS originals or manufacture uploaded files.

Current native source reads and authoring assembly retain object/parent access, native fact freshness and canonical disposition checks. Authoring assembly already supplies its exact manifest reread through the captured SDK callback.

Saved Quality reports retain exact native-parent receipts and current actor/project/object admission before read/export; stripped bundle metadata cannot replace canonical run receipts. Historical facts are not relabeled current approvals.

No supported new Quality report-to-artifact-registry transfer was found: report persistence writes report_runs/report_snapshots/report_run_dependencies; native projection writes cre_evidence_sources. QMS report_artifact_id/minutes_artifact_id point in the opposite direction to existing artifacts.

The registry artifact adapter remains a distinct exact current artifact/project/disposition/hash materializer with governed unbound-copy and no inherited source approval/signature. The new ReportOS access additions do not modify canAccessReportProject used by this adapter.
P100 keeps Quality project-door/QP3/mobile overflow and CMC/RBM/Biostatistics parity with their current owners; this native Quality completion pattern does not claim that parity.
limits: No current Quality test/full gate/build success is asserted by this review. Existing incoming evidence and prior16fe/f429 gates retain their own checkpoints.
Zero selected UI intersections do not qualify newly changed native source/backend/stream behavior or a full transitive dependency graph.
No deployment, live model, scientific sufficiency, signature/approval inheritance, external delivery or full medical-device/diagnostic feature parity is qualified.
